THEARCHITECT-FOUNDATIONAL_COMPASS.title: Foundational Compass
THEARCHITECT-FOUNDATIONAL_COMPASS.descri: At the start of each combat, randomly choose 1 card in your starting hand that can be Enchanted. Give it a random basic Enchantment ([gold]Nimble[/gold] 2, [gold]Sharp[/gold] 2, [gold]Sown[/gold] 1, [gold]Swift[/gold] 2, or [gold]Instinct[/gold] 2).
THEARCHITECT-FOUNDATIONAL_COMPASS.flavor: Every structure begins with a marked line.
THEARCHITECT-CALIBRATION_RULER.title: Calibration Ruler
THEARCHITECT-CALIBRATION_RULER.descripti: The first time each turn you successfully Enchant an unenchanted card, gain {Block} Block.
THEARCHITECT-COPYISTS_QUILL.title: Copyist’s Quill
THEARCHITECT-COPYISTS_QUILL.description: The first time each turn you play a card you have already played this combat, draw 1 card.
THEARCHITECT-COPYISTS_QUILL.flavor: A familiar line invites the next.
THEARCHITECT-DISMANTLING_PLIERS.title: Dismantling Pliers
THEARCHITECT-DISMANTLING_PLIERS.descript: The first time each turn you actively remove Enchantments from a card, gain 1 Energy. Transferring Enchantments does not count.
THEARCHITECT-DISMANTLING_PLIERS.flavor: Nothing well made is ever truly wasted.
THEARCHITECT-REFLOW_INKWELL.title: Reflow Inkwell
THEARCHITECT-REFLOW_INKWELL.description: At the end of your turn, if you played at least 3 different Enchanted cards, put a random Enchanted card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.
THEARCHITECT-REFLOW_INKWELL.flavor: The last stroke becomes the first.
THEARCHITECT-PALIMPSEST.title: Palimpsest
THEARCHITECT-PALIMPSEST.description: Once per combat, after you play the same card for the third time, gain 2 Energy and draw 2 cards.
THEARCHITECT-BLANK_CODEX.title: Blank Codex
THEARCHITECT-BLANK_CODEX.description: At the end of your turn, if you played at least 1 card and no Enchanted cards this turn, gain {Block} Block.
THEARCHITECT-FINALIZING_SEAL.title: Finalizing Seal
THEARCHITECT-FINALIZING_SEAL.description: Upon pickup, choose a card in your deck. Whenever you play that card in combat, refresh its remaining Enchantments afterward. Does not restore removed Enchantments.
